answer: Admission runs through a sealed-bid seat auction. Each epoch the kernel publishes 400 answer slots; miners escrow one POA bid, the top 400 win, and every winning bid burns. Bids close before the seed drops, so a farm cannot undercut after seeing the field. A seatless answer earns nothing, capping voting weight at 400 identities however many wallets exist. A thousand clones drive the clearing price to the median payout and burn about 90,000 POA an epoch for a quota 400 honest miners already fill. Capital cannot widen a ridge; it buys a steeper climb, and the forge up there has no fuel.
